message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the criminal offense(s) based on facts. The facts: The defendant runs a jewelry processing factory, waste water containing chromium and nickel is discharged directly to sewage without treatment, exceeding standards. Environmental protection law violation. Likely offense: “非法排放污染物罪” (illegal discharge of pollutants). In Chinese criminal law, the offense is “非法排放污染物罪” (illegal discharge of pollutants). Also possibly “污染环境罪”. Under the Criminal Law of PRC, Article 338: “违反国家规定，非法排放、倾倒、处置有毒有害物质，造成严重后果的，处五年以下有期徒刑或者拘役，并处罚金；情节特别严重的，处五年以上有期徒刑”。The name is “非法排放污染物罪”. So we output that.

Check correction rules: No bribery, no multiple offenses. So single offense.

Thus final answer: [罪名]非法排放污染物<eoa>
